nodes.description: Public mapping of account balances; updated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances; written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Privileged owner address set in constructor; gates init, batchSend, delegate and setTradeAddress.
Whitelisted trade address that bypasses the ensure() sale restrictions.
Per-account whitelist mapping that lets arbitrary addresses skip ensure() checks.
Per-sender sale counter incremented on each transferFrom and read by condition().
Total token supply scaled by 10**decimals in the constructor without SafeMath.
Hard-coded Uniswap router address constant whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale accounts, then enforces condition().
Public payable transfer that mutates allowance and balances directly without SafeMath.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale restrictions.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer loop that multiplies and subtracts balances without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter writing the tradeAddress bypass account.
Internal pure CREATE2-style pair address derivation used by ensure().
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender and granting UNI infinite allowance.
Low-level delegatecall executed on an arbitrary address chosen by the owner.
Balance and supply math performed with raw -=, += and * instead of SafeMath.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowances and the _from whitelist path.
Source account parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Amount parameter fed into unchecked balance arithmetic.
Recipient parameter of transfer forwarded into transferFrom.
Loop index controlling the batchSend transfer loop.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards to transferFrom() using msg.sender as _from.
transferFrom() requires ensure() to pass before mutating state.
ensure() calls condition() for sale limit checks.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address through pairFor().
Owner-guarded delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall.
transferFrom() updates allowance and balances with unchecked -= and +=.
batchSend() multiplies and subtracts balances without SafeMath.
msg.sender is used as the unverified _from in transferFrom checks and allowance accounting.
batchSend() authorization depends solely on msg.sender == owner.
delegate() authorization depends solely on msg.sender == owner.
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
constructor assigns ownership and the initial balance to msg.sender.
transfer() passes msg.sender as _from into the whitelist-gated transferFrom().
_from is compared against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure(), enabling whitelist bypass.
_from is the source account debited inside transferFrom().
_value flows directly into unchecked balance arithmetic.
_to is the recipient parameter passed from transfer() into transferFrom().
loop index i drives every iteration of the batchSend() transfer loop.
balanceOf mapping is read and written with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom().
canSale[_from] whitelist entry lets an account bypass all ensure() restrictions.
tradeAddress value bypasses the ensure() sale restrictions.
_onSaleNum counter is read by condition() when enforcing _saleNum.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress bypass account used by ensure().
totalSupply is scaled by 10**decimals without SafeMath in the constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful inside the transferFrom/ensure logic.
_value feeds the unchecked arithmetic balance updates.
_to is the recipient parameter used by transfer().
loop index i is local to the batchSend() loop.
